title: One authored file in a planned change set
$comment: Shared by the per-batch artifact and the merged plan so a batch cannot describe a change the plan would refuse. A lock file is not on this list: its integrity hashes come from a resolver, so the plan names the manifest to resolve under materializations instead.

path.description: A lock file written from literal content is an invented lock file: only a resolver can state the exact version, origin URL and content hash of every package in a tree. Name the manifest under materializations instead. One name per ecosystem this installation ships an adapter for, and a test keeps this list and the adapters in step. Both separators are refused because path scoping normalises backslashes to forward slashes later.
